title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
abstract: arXiv:2610.37656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = \Psi(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $\Psi$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFo

translated_title: 注意力作为格点规范理论：关系仅通过威尔逊圈相互作用
translated_abstract: 关系通过它们所共享的实体进行复合——Alice是Bob的母亲，Bob是Carol的父亲，因此Alice是Carol的祖母——而且顺序至关重要，因为“父亲的母亲”并不等同于“母亲的父亲”；验证一个复合关系意味着闭合这个环。我们证明，如果每个实体的坐标系可以独立旋转（逐实体的参考系自由度），则可以得出三个结论。在纯规范扇区中，不共享任何环路的关系完全无法相互作用。三角形唯一规范不变的评分是其和乐（holonomy）H = T_ij T_jk T_ki 的类函数——即一个威尔逊圈。而边唯一的等变更新形式为 U = Ψ(H) T_ij，其中 Ψ 是共轭等变的。因此，基于威尔逊圈的边注意力并非众多设计中的一种，而是对称性所允许的唯一形式。三个研究群体分别掌握了这一形式的局部：知识图谱的交换算子嵌入构成了其阿贝尔（可交换）扇区；AlphaFo……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文证明，在允许每个实体独立旋转自身坐标系的规范对称性下，基于威尔逊圈（闭合环路和乐）的边注意力机制不是众多候选设计之一，而是对称性唯一允许的形式——关系之间只能通过共享的闭合环路发生相互作用。
en_tdlr: Under per-entity gauge frame freedom, edge attention scored by Wilson loops of the holonomy is the unique symmetry-permitted form—relations can only interact through shared closed loops.
